title: Solvers: analytic ODE1 Jacobians and the ODE2-ODE1 coupling of objects, C_y^T lambda in the ODE1 rows
author: Claude-JG
description: For ObjectGenericDAE (#3143; decided: analytic Jacobians by new C++ functions, only for objects with ODE1 coordinates). CObject::ComputeJacobianODE1RHS (the ODE1 RHS by the local ODE1, ODE2 coordinates and velocities) and ComputeJacobianODE2_ODE1 (the ODE2 LHS by the ODE1 coordinates), called for an object that sets the flags ODE1_ODE1_function (ODE1_ODE2_function, ODE1_ODE2_t_function) or ODE2_ODE1_function, else numerical; the coupling block also for an object with an analytic ODE2 Jacobian, which got none. CSystem::NumericalJacobianODE1RHS becomes JacobianODE1RHS, replacing an empty placeholder of that name that solver.ComputeJacobianODE1RHS called (it added nothing). ObjectGenericODE1 gives its Jacobian without rhsUserFunction: the system matrix. The reaction terms C_y^T lambda in the ODE1 rows of the implicit (and static) solver residual, ComputeODE1ProjectedReactionTerms; JacobianAE puts the block AE_ODE1 and its transpose at their rows and columns (they were at wrong offsets and refused objects with ODE1 coordinates), with the factors of the solver.
releaseNotes: CObject::ComputeJacobianODE1RHS and ComputeJacobianODE2_ODE1: analytic ODE1 Jacobians and ODE2-ODE1 coupling of objects that set their flags, else numerical, the coupling also for objects with an analytic ODE2 Jacobian; ObjectGenericODE1 without rhsUserFunction gives its system matrix as Jacobian; solver.ComputeJacobianODE1RHS adds the ODE1 Jacobian (it added nothing); C_y^T lambda in the ODE1 rows of the implicit and static solver, the AE_ODE1 block of JacobianAE at its rows and columns
